title: Parse percent-encoded key=value pairs into a LinkedHashMap
contract: Splits on ';', then each segment on its first '=' only. Percent-decodes keys and values as UTF-8; '+' stays literal. Empty values allowed, empty keys not. Repeated keys: last value wins, first position kept. Empty segments skipped. Null or blank gives an empty map. Iteration is first-seen key order. A segment without '=', an empty key, or a malformed escape throws IllegalArgumentException.
notShownInJavadoc: percent decoding of space and semicolon
